name: Eshbon
title: Son of Gad
summary: Eshbon was one of the sons of Gad, who was a son of Jacob and Zilpah. He is mentioned among those who followed Jacob to Egypt when the family settled there during the famine. Eshbon is counted among the founders of Israel's tribal clans through the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Gad
keyEvents.description: Esbon is listed as one of the seven sons of Gad in the genealogy in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's family travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Esbon was among the 70 people in Jacob's household who traveled to Egypt to settle in Goshen during the famine.

keyEvents.title: The genealogy in Numbers
keyEvents.description: Esbon is mentioned again in the census of the tribes of Israel in the wilderness, where his descendants form a clan within the tribe of Gad. He is also called Osbon here.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Gad in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Esbon's lineage is confirmed in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of the tribe of Gad.
